title: 第1746章 奎瓦统领第1745章 雷魔残
content_zh:
“啊！”
那魔族统领吓坏了，寒毛都在倒竖。
这紫色雷霆太可怕了，在渗入体内的刹那，他的残破雷气，几乎是丝毫无法汇聚。
这不是侵蚀，而是镇压。
他何时见到，这世上竟然有如此恐怖的雷霆，还是出现在一个仅仅星台境之人的身上。
“人族小子，找死！”
与那魔族统领同来的，还有数十名大藏境六重的魔族强者，他们也一个个的纷纷低吼起来，体内的魔气疯狂涌动，打算围攻肖恩。
数十个全身覆盖了浓郁至极魔气的大藏境六重的魔族强者，朝着肖恩所在的地方狂奔而来。
“哼！”
肖恩嘴角露出一抹冷笑，不问不顾，双手举起黑尺，这黑尺犹如主宰天地的神兵利器，直接怒劈而出。
被紫色雷海困住的魔族统领大骇，万万没想到自己的攻击在肖恩面前如此不堪一击。
毫无疑问，这—尺劈过来，那么他的死期也就到了。
“死！”
肖恩目中厉芒闪烁着，体内玄黄之力涌动，源源不断的力量涌入那玄重尺当中，令玄重尺的光芒也愈来愈盛，爆出更强的速度跟威能。
“住手！”
一个声音，如雷鸣一般在遥远的天际炸响，所有人一惊，向来人看去，神色凝重起来。
“斩！”
肖恩没有丝毫理会来人的喝声，手中的玄重尺迅速的斩下。
“跑！”
那魔族统领眼中闪过一抹惊恐之色，不过他的反应也是极快的，瞬间便清醒过来，毫不犹豫的往后退去，想要逃脱肖恩的斩杀。

另一边，那道喝声的主人以及众多魔族强者，也是一个个神色焦急的迅速而来。
只是，他们的速度快，肖恩的速度更快。
唰！
一抹尺光闪过，肖恩的玄重尺迅速无比的斩向那魔族统领，速度快到了极致。
“不好！”
那魔族统领狂吼，身上猛然爆发出一股强大的魔气，化为一阵狂风，向着肖恩席卷过来。
现在的他，自然不求斩杀肖恩，但求阻挡肖恩片刻。
只要片刻时间，驰援之人便会追上来。
“不知死活！”
肖恩面无表情，眼中露出杀机，玄重尺落下，划过大片大片的魔气。
这大藏境六重强者的魔气，在现在的肖恩面前却那么的苍白无力，根本无法抵挡肖恩的这一尺。
眨眼时间不到，肖恩的玄重尺便已轰开了大片的魔气，直接出现在那魔族统领的面前。
轰！
肖恩身形一动，狂暴的重尺，撕裂一切阻挡，破空杀伐，以劈天之势直接斩向那魔族统领。
“不！
！”
那魔族统领满眼惊恐之色，死死的盯着上空的玄重尺，神色说不出的惊惧、不甘。
静！
全场死静！
就连四周正在交战中的人魔两族强者都是停了手，呆呆的望着那片天空。

没有一个人敢想象，这个刚刚主宰了大藏境五重层次的少年，现在面对着那大藏境六重的魔族统领，依旧强势碾杀。
摧枯拉朽的碾杀！
这一刻，肖恩成了整个战场人族强者心中的偶像。
“这个家伙！”
content_en:
"Ah!"
The demon leader was so frightened that his hair stood on end.
This purple thunder was so terrifying. The moment it penetrated into his body, his broken thunder energy was almost unable to gather at all.
This is not erosion, but suppression.
When did he see such terrifying thunder in this world, and it appeared in the body of a person who was only in the Star Platform Realm.
"Human boy, you are seeking death!"
Along with the demon leader, there were dozens of powerful demons at the sixth level of the Great Tibet Realm. They also roared one by one, the demonic energy in their bodies surged crazily, and they planned to besiege Sean.
Dozens of powerful demons from the sixth level of the Great Tibetan Realm, whose entire bodies were covered with extremely strong demonic aura, rushed towards the place where Sean was.
"Hmph!"
A sneer appeared at the corner of Sean's mouth. He raised the black ruler with both hands without hesitation. The black ruler was like a magical weapon that dominated the world, and it was struck out angrily.
Da Hai, the leader of the demon clan who was trapped by the purple sea of ​​thunder, never expected that his attack would be so vulnerable to Sean.
There is no doubt that if this one-foot attack comes, his death will come.
"Death!"
Sean's eyes flashed fiercely, and the black and yellow power surged in his body. A steady stream of power poured into the Xuan Zhong Ruler, making the Xuan Zhong Ruler's light become stronger and stronger, exploding with stronger speed and power.
"Stop!"
A sound exploded like thunder in the distant sky. Everyone was startled and looked at the person coming, their expressions became solemn.
"Cut!"
Sean didn't pay any attention to the shouts of the visitor, and quickly cut down the Xuanzhong Ruler in his hand.
"Run!"
A look of panic flashed in the demon leader's eyes, but his reaction was also extremely fast. He woke up instantly and stepped back without hesitation, trying to escape Xiao En's execution.
On the other side, the owner of the shout and many strong demons also came quickly with anxious expressions.
It's just that they are fast, and Sean is faster.
Uh-huh!
A flash of ruler light flashed, and Sean's Xuan Zhong Ruler slashed at the demon leader extremely quickly, reaching the extreme speed.
"Not good!"
The demon leader roared wildly, and a powerful demonic energy suddenly erupted from his body, turning into a gust of wind and sweeping towards Sean.
Now, of course, he doesn't want to kill Sean, but he wants to stop Sean for a moment.
It only takes a moment for the rescuers to catch up.
"I don't know whether to live or die!"
Sean's face was expressionless, with murderous intent in his eyes, and the Xuan Zhong ruler fell, crossing large swaths of demonic energy.
The demonic aura of this sixth-level Da Zang realm powerhouse was so pale and powerless in front of Sean now, and could not withstand Sean's attack at all.
In less than a blink of an eye, Sean's Xuan Zhong Ruler had blasted away a large amount of demonic energy and appeared directly in front of the demon leader.
boom!
With a movement of his body, Sean used his violent heavy ruler to tear apart all obstacles, cut through the air and slashed directly at the demon leader with a force that split the sky.
"No!
! "
The demon leader's eyes were full of horror, and he stared at the Xuan Zhong Ruler in the sky with an expression of indescribable fear and unwillingness.
quiet!
The whole place was silent!
Even the powerful men from the human and demon tribes who were fighting around them stopped their hands and stared blankly at the sky.
No one dared to imagine that this young man who had just dominated the fifth level of the Great Tibetan realm was now facing the demon leader of the sixth level of the Great Tibetan realm and was still crushing him with force.
A devastating crushing kill!
At this moment, Sean became the idol in the hearts of all the powerful human beings on the battlefield.
"This guy!"
